name: SQL Injection Tautology
description: Detects classic tautology-based SQL injection (e.g., ' OR '1'='1) aiming to bypass authentication.

name: SQL UNION-Based Data Exfiltration
description: Flags UNION SELECT queries designed to extract schema or credentials from adjacent database tables.

name: Cross-Site Scripting Tag Injection
description: Identifies inline HTML script tags injected into request parameters or headers.

name: DOM Event Handler Injection
description: Detects DOM-based JavaScript event handler attributes within untrusted user input.

name: Path Traversal Directory Climbing
description: Flags sequences of parent directory climbing (../ or ..\) attempting to escape web roots.

name: OS Command Chaining & Injection
description: Detects shell metacharacters followed by critical binary invocations.

name: Administrative Endpoint Probing
description: Identifies unauthorized reconnaissance sweeps probing sensitive backend administration portals.

name: Sensitive File & Key Exfiltration
description: Detects access requests targeting environment configurations, SSH keys, or system credentials.

name: Executable Malware Payload Delivery
description: Flags outbound or inbound traffic requesting executable binary or script payloads.

name: Webshell & Backdoor File Access
description: Detects requests interacting with known PHP webshell and backdoor command interfaces.

name: Cloud Metadata SSRF Probe
description: Identifies attempts to query cloud instance metadata service endpoints (AWS/GCP/Azure).

name: Unencrypted Cleartext Transport
description: Flags cleartext HTTP URLs transmitting potentially unencrypted session identifiers.

name: Log4Shell JNDI Injection Probe
description: Detects CVE-2021-44228 Log4j JNDI lookup strings targeting logging subsystems.
